faq.q: What song plays inside the MegaMundo building in the GTA 6 Extended Look?
faq.a: Phil Collins' 1984 ballad "Against All Odds (Take a Look at Me Now)" plays there. It runs from roughly 21:33 to 21:56 in Grand Theft Auto VI's Netflix Extended Look, right after Jason drops off Lucia, Petra, and Valentina on one of the building's floors.

faq.q: Who sings Against All Odds in GTA 6?
faq.a: Phil Collins. The song is his 1984 solo ballad, and it was identified in the Netflix Extended Look by GameRant, which timestamped the placement inside the MegaMundo building.

faq.q: When was Against All Odds first heard in GTA 6 footage?
faq.a: It appeared in the GTA VI Netflix Extended Look, a 26 minute gameplay preview that premiered on August 27, 2026. GameRant published its timestamped breakdown of the song the following day.

faq.q: Is Against All Odds an official Rockstar soundtrack credit for GTA 6?
faq.a: The record here comes from press documentation of the Netflix Extended Look, not from a Rockstar-published tracklist. Whether Rockstar has separately credited the song on an official list has not been stated in this source.
